verdict.rationale: Workable is a SaaS ATS, so headless operation means driving it without the UI. Its documented token-authenticated REST API and official MCP server provide that programmatic access, so non-interactive scripts can run it. There is no evidence of a CLI, a CI integration or headless-run guidance, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation or examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
The Workable MCP server provides full programmatic access to the Workable recruiting and HR platform.
